facts.text: MuJoCoYAMEnv is a Gymnasium environment (gym.Env) for a bimanual YAM robot whose actions and observations use the 14D policy-space order [left_j1..6, left_gripper, right_j1..6, right_gripper]
The per-step action space is a Box over 14 elements with low -1.0 and high 1.0
single_timestep_action_dim is 7 times the number of configured robots, 14 in the base configuration
The observation is a Dict with per-camera (3, camera_height, camera_width) uint8 images, a 14-element float32 state, per-camera Discrete(2) masks, a prompt Text and per-camera float64 timestamps
project_policy_state maps MuJoCo qpos into the 14D policy state and clips each gripper element to qpos/_GRIPPER_CTRL_MAX in [0, 1]
The base configuration defines three cameras (top, left, right) and two robots (left, right), each robot with seven init_q values
get_i2rt_sim_config builds the base configuration, marks every follower as simulation and may override each robot's init_q from the DEPLOY_INIT_Q environment variable
reset calls mj_resetData and then restores the arm pose returned by _get_reset_arm_state
reset passes options['randomization'] to the task randomizer and may adopt a prompt from the randomization metadata
reset puts the native randomization outcome into info['randomization'] when it exists
RandomizationState.to_dict returns seed, object_states, scale_states and metadata
_get_reset_arm_state returns the current 14D arm pose when the arm state is initialized and otherwise the concatenated init_q; forget_arm_state clears the initialized flag
step applies one 14D action and returns the Gymnasium 5-tuple; step_chunk stops at the first terminated or truncated step
_step_single writes the 14D action into the actuator controls and advance_physics runs control_decimation mj_step calls
The default physics_dt is 0.002 s and control_decimation is 17, about 0.034 s per control transition
terminated is true only when terminate_on_success is set and the task evaluator reports success; truncated is true when cur_step reaches max_episode_steps and the episode is not terminated
The reward is the task evaluator's scalar reward, or 0.0 when no evaluator is attached
make_env is the public task-to-environment factory; its default task is 'bottles' and it returns MuJoCoYAMEnv
get_obs returns images, masks, state, prompt and camera_timestamps; the masks are all True and the timestamps are the simulation time
close closes the camera backend
capture_state returns copies of qpos, qvel and the simulated time
The runtime dependencies include mujoco~=3.8.0 and gymnasium>=1.1
The README documents the stable API: reset(seed, randomize), step(action_14d), step_chunk(action_chunk), action_space shape (14,) and the observation keys

determinism.notes: reset(seed) records the seed and the kinematic transition has no random draw, so one sequence of actions repeats exactly on a fresh or forgotten state; the upstream MuJoCo model draws its task randomization from the seed

gaps: kinematic stand-in: each step makes the commanded 14D policy values the new state; there are no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, task evaluator or randomizer, unlike the upstream MuJoCo model

the fake's 14D state is the last commanded policy action; it does not project MuJoCo qpos, so its gripper element is not clipped and normalized to [0, 1] the way project_policy_state does (abc_sim/env.py:31-47)
the fake ignores reset options and its seed has no random draw; the upstream passes options['randomization'] to the task randomizer (abc_sim/env.py:319-336)

the fake supplies a placeholder RandomizationState-shaped metadata fixture, not a sampled scene; both backends use sim.py to convert the upstream-shaped reset metadata with to_dict() so the Gymnasium bridge retains it as JSON instead of dropping the info object
the fake returns 3x4x4 placeholder images for the three camera names; the upstream defaults render 3x480x640 per camera (abc_sim/env.py:87-88) and both the size and the camera set are configurable
reset is partial: like the upstream it preserves the current 14D arm pose across resets unless forget_arm_state() is called (abc_sim/env.py:304-315, :498-510)
no wall-clock pacing: ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no protocol snapshot: the upstream exposes capture_state() but no set_state(), so snapshot_restore is false
the fake does not model rewards or success: it returns reward 0.0 and never terminates; upstream also returns 0.0 when no evaluator is attached
the fake was never compared with the upstream MuJoCo environment; mujoco and gymnasium are not installed where the gate runs

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
